findings.detail: Debt schedule rows disclose interest fields such as Ref. Rate/Cash/PIK, but the extracted debt coverage metric shows only 356 of 803 debt rows with stored rates.

rationale: C01 failed because only 55.7% of 803 extracted debt rows have a stored interest rate, below the 0.8 threshold. The raw schedule is not rate-less: debt tables expose Ref. Rate, Cash, and PIK columns, and representative debt rows disclose rates such as ABB/Con-cise Optical Group LLC with S+ and 7.50% cash and AAM Series 1.1 Rail and Domestic Intermodal Feeder, LLC with 12.00%. The blank interest_rate values shown in the bundle for multiple private credit debt rows are therefore an extraction/mapping gap rather than a false alarm.
